meta.description: Sign in with the browser Digital Credentials API, with a fallback to wallet app selection.

noscript.message: JavaScript must be enabled to use this page.

supportText: We will try signing in with the browser Digital Credentials API if your device and wallet app support it.
unsupportedText: This browser does not support the Digital Credentials API. Continue by choosing a wallet app.
statusSuccess: Presentation completed (demo). In a real environment the data would return to the Relying Party.
statusCancelled: Operation cancelled. You can choose a wallet app to continue.
statusError: The request did not succeed. You can choose a wallet app to continue.
statusNoProvider: No system-registered wallet matched this request. You can choose a wallet app to continue.
